the non-separable and the tensor-product box splines and B-splines are not only optimal in terms of their frequency-domain behavior, but also very well suited in practice for BCC-sampled data.

the BCC lattice offers a promising approach for the reconstruction of continuous signals from their discrete BCC-samples.
